payload.name: Multimodal Feedback Synergy
payload.fact: Multimodal feedback (combining visual and haptic cues) improves the speed and reliability of belief updates in drone operation while avoiding the cognitive load elevation associated with haptic-only feedback.
payload.boundary: Supervisory control of autonomous drones in urban environments.

provenance.title: Multimodal feedback enhances human belief updating performance and reduces cognitive load in urban drone operation
provenance.quote_or_locus: Together, the findings indicate a multimodal synergy that improves both speed and reliability of belief updates without the cognitive-load elevation observed under haptic-only feedback
